registros.pergunta: Quais campeões foram mais banidos em 2026?

JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT champion_id, champion_name FROM participants) c

resultados.sql:
SELECT league, champion, jogos
FROM (
  SELECT pg.league, pp.champion, COUNT(*) AS jogos,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY pg.league ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn
  FROM pro_players pp
  JOIN pro_games pg ON pg.game_id = pp.game_id AND pg.side = pp.side
  WHERE pg.year = 2026
  GROUP BY pg.league, pp.champion
) ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY league;

registros.pergunta: Quais campeões tiveram o maior aumento na taxa de escolha entre dois patches consecutivos?

erro.sql:
SELECT 
  pp1.champion,
  pg1.patch AS patch_anterior,
  pg2.patch AS patch_novo,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN pg1.year = pg2.year AND pg1.split = pg2.split THEN 1 END)::float / 
    NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN pg1.year = pg2.year AND pg1.split = pg2.split THEN pg1.game_id END), 0) AS taxa_patch_anterior,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN pg2.year = pg2.year AND pg2.split = pg2.split THEN 1 END)::float / 
    NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN pg2.year = pg2.year AND pg2.split = pg2.split THEN pg2.game_id END), 0) AS taxa_patch_novo,
  (COUNT(CASE WHEN pg2.year = pg2.year AND pg2.split = pg2.split THEN 1 END)::float / 
    NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN pg2.year = pg2.year AND pg2.split = pg2.split THEN pg2.game_id END), 0)) -
  (COUNT(CASE WHEN pg1.year = pg2.year AND pg1.split = pg2.split THEN 1 END)::float / 
    NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN pg1.year = pg2.year AND pg1.split = pg2.split THEN pg1.game_id END), 0)) AS aumento_taxa
FROM pro_players pp1
JOIN pro_games pg1 ON pg1.game_id = pp1.game_id AND pg1.side = pp1.side
JOIN pro_players pp2 ON pp2.champion = pp1.champion
JOIN pro_games pg2 ON pg2.game_id = pp2.game_id AND pg2.side = pp2.side
WHERE pg1.patch < pg2.patch
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM pro_games pg_between
    WHERE pg_between.patch > pg1.patch AND pg_between.patch < pg2.patch
  )
GROUP BY pp1.champion, pg1.patch, pg2.patch
ORDER BY aumento_taxa DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;
